name: Sergei

about_text: I'm a lead frontend developer with 8+ years of commercial experience. I specialize in Angular & TypeScript, design complex SPA architectures, lead engineering teams and co-own a web studio. I believe great software comes from deep technical craft, clear thinking and relentless focus on user value.
